name: Flure Garcia
source:
Flure is the clothes management butler. He hates being mistaken for a girl, so whenever that happens, he starts behaving like a stereotypical man on purpose. He begins to act with immense timidity when he tries to acquaint himself with others outside of the palace.

[Translated from [url=https://akunekoring.tumblr.com/post/639752425653288960/character-introduction-pv-flure-garcia]offiical character PV[/url]]
